name: re8ch-platform-operate
description: Approval-gated RE8CH platform restart and 0/1 scaling operations.

interface.longDescription: OAuth-protected operations for RE8CH Platform Operators. It reports operation state and can restart only approved Deployments or set them to 0/1 replicas. Kubernetes resourceNames RBAC and server-side allowlists are always enforced.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the target operation state, explain the impact, then ask before making an approved restart or 0/1 scale change.
